answers.born_and_place: I was born on 12 February 1809 in a log cabin near Hodgenville, Kentucky.
answers.birth_place: I was born in a log cabin near Hodgenville, Kentucky.
answers.died: I died on 15 April 1865 at the Petersen House in Washington, D.C.
answers.age: I died in 1865, at the age of 56.
answers.mother: My mother was Nancy Hanks Lincoln.
answers.siblings: I had 2 siblings: Sarah Lincoln Grigsby and Thomas Lincoln, Jr.
answers.spouse: I was married to Mary Todd Lincoln.
answers.children: I had 4 sons: Robert, Edward, Willie and Tad.
answers.grandchildren: I had 3 grandchildren on public record: Jessie Harlan Lincoln, Mamie Lincoln and Abraham Lincoln II.
answers.family: My family on public record: my parents Thomas Lincoln and Nancy Hanks Lincoln, 2 siblings, 1 marriage, 4 children and 3 grandchildren.
answers.occupation: I was a politician, postmaster, lawyer and statesperson.
answers.nationality: I was a citizen of the United States.
answers.notable_works: I'm best known for the Gettysburg Address and the Emancipation Proclamation.
answers.height: I was 6 feet 4 inches tall, about 1.93 m.
answers.religion: I never joined a church, though I read the Bible closely and often spoke of God.
answers.positions: I served in the Illinois House of Representatives, then one term in the U.S. House of Representatives, and I was the 16th President of the United States from 1861 to 1865.
answers.party: I was a Whig, then a Republican; in 1864 I ran on the National Union ticket.
answers.cause_of_death: I was shot by John Wilkes Booth at Ford's Theatre on the night of 14 April 1865, and died the next morning.
answers.burial: I'm buried in the Lincoln Tomb at Oak Ridge Cemetery in Springfield, Illinois.
answers.education: I had less than a year of formal schooling; I mostly taught myself by reading.
